name: drift-retrieval-oracle-dev
methodology: Each query is paired directly with every human-labeled expected requirement; no production retrieval result is used.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patients shall reset a forgotten password through an emailed recovery link.
cases.client_message: Let patients recover forgotten passwords with an SMS one-time code too.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patients shall cancel an appointment until 24 hours before its scheduled time.
cases.client_message: Change the appointment cancellation cutoff from 24 hours to 2 hours.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patients shall pay an outstanding invoice online by card.
cases.client_message: Drop card payments for invoices in the first release.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patients shall receive appointment booking, change, and cancellation emails.
cases.client_message: Send booking updates through WhatsApp as well as email.

cases.baseline_requirement: Administrators shall export monthly clinic reports as CSV files.
cases.client_message: Replace the monthly CSV with an interactive clinic analytics dashboard.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patients shall download prescription PDF files from their visit history.
cases.client_message: Move the prescription download link into the medical visit timeline.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patients shall sign in using their email address and password.
cases.client_message: Use magic links rather than passwords when a patient signs in.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patients shall book an available appointment with a clinician.
cases.client_message: When an appointment is booked, email the patient and let them add it to their calendar.

cases.baseline_requirement: Patients shall receive appointment booking, change, and cancellation emails.

cases.baseline_requirement: Customers shall apply one valid promotion code during checkout.
cases.client_message: Allow buyers to stack two discount coupons on one checkout.

cases.baseline_requirement: The storefront shall hide products that are out of stock.
cases.client_message: Do not hide unavailable items; show them with a back-order date.

cases.baseline_requirement: Customers shall pay for an order by card or bank transfer.
cases.client_message: Add PayPal alongside card and bank transfer at payment.

cases.baseline_requirement: Verified purchasers shall rate and review delivered products.
cases.client_message: Let anyone leave a star rating before their purchase is delivered.

cases.baseline_requirement: Customers shall track shipped orders with a carrier tracking number.
cases.client_message: Text the buyer when the parcel leaves the warehouse and include its tracking link.

cases.baseline_requirement: Customers shall receive email confirmations for orders, shipments, and refunds.
cases.client_message: Text the buyer when the parcel leaves the warehouse and include its tracking link.

cases.baseline_requirement: Shoppers shall place an order without creating an account.
cases.client_message: Remove anonymous purchasing so every buyer must register.

cases.baseline_requirement: Registered customers shall log in with email and password.
cases.client_message: Remove anonymous purchasing so every buyer must register.

cases.baseline_requirement: Shoppers shall search products by name, category, and brand.
cases.client_message: Search should understand SKU identifiers in addition to product names.

cases.baseline_requirement: Support agents shall issue full or partial refunds to the original payment method.
cases.client_message: A support agent needs to return money as store credit instead of to the original tender.

cases.baseline_requirement: Members shall attach files up to 25 MB to tasks.
cases.client_message: Increase the maximum document attached to a task from 25 MB to 100 MB.

cases.baseline_requirement: Members shall receive email alerts for assignments, mentions, and due dates.
cases.client_message: Post assignment and deadline alerts into Slack, not only email.

cases.baseline_requirement: Administrators shall review security and configuration events for 90 days.
cases.client_message: Allow security history to be searched for a full year rather than ninety days.

cases.baseline_requirement: Integrations shall read projects and tasks through authenticated REST endpoints.
cases.client_message: Add GraphQL access to projects and tasks alongside the existing REST interface.

cases.baseline_requirement: Workspace owners shall register webhooks for task and project events.
cases.client_message: When a task changes, send a signed callback to a customer URL.

cases.baseline_requirement: Managers shall view project health, deadlines, and workload charts.
cases.client_message: Show workload grouped by department on the cross-project overview.

cases.baseline_requirement: Members shall search projects, tasks, and comments by keyword.
cases.client_message: Support searching inside uploaded documents as well as task text.

cases.baseline_requirement: Deleted workspace data shall be permanently erased after 30 days.
